sentences.en: [Music] my name is lorraine angelicos and i am the rising senior class president with pompano beach high school in pompano beach florida i'm writing on behalf of the students of
pompano beach high school i wanted to reach out to you now in hopes that i could persuade you to be our commencement speaker at my graduation
my graduation will be may 29 2020. you're probably saying 2020 yes 2020 a guy of your calibers put years in advance
i wanted to possibly see if you're available and if you would consider addressing my senior class i saw a story on you and you how you became the superstar that you are today

thank you for calling me superstar you sound like my mom lorena your story is incredible your story of how you started with having aspirations of becoming a professional football player and a devastating injury led you on a
different path not the dream you had hoped for or aspired for ultimately resulting in your seven bucks moment as a turning point in your life like you
i believe the same as one door closes another one opens you just have to have the drive and willpower to go through that next door
and give it your all now as you can already see this is when i got this letter yeah it knocked me off my feet it put me
it sat me down because it's not what lorraine is saying but it's how she's saying and the timing of this the way the universe
works by the grace of god kismet if you will how this letter came into my life this was the thing that really it's the thing that really it sat me down we are willing to
fundraise to bring you to speak please advise on what your requirements are travel
food etc i don't know the rain my food bill is really high i don't know if you guys can afford to afford that thank you in advance for considering my invitation
i hope to receive a positive reply from you as soon as possible lorraine i would have done this for free

i would have traveled the world around the world twice and back just to come and speak to you guys during graduation and we had a normal had you guys had a normal graduation had we been under different circumstances
you guys had an actual graduation i would have been there but here's the thing lorraine that sealed the deal as part of a good faith request i have
enclosed seven bucks as a down payment for your services
